items.title: Your Micron Shares Could Swing Hundreds Of Dollars, And That Is The Calm Case
items.summary: Micron Technology (MU) stock trades near $1,082. Options expiring in roughly a year price a likely range from about $597 to about $1,963, with roughly two-in-three odds of finishing inside it. That is a huge band. Yet options expect Micron to trade calmer than it has, and the supply contracts behind management's case for steadier results cover a minority of its memory volume.
